title: guajava suffruticosa
intro: Guajava suffruticosa, commonly known as Guayusa, is a species of holly tree native to the Amazon rainforest. Guayusa is a type of medicinal plant with various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and lowering blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Guayusa include caffeine, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as acting as an antioxidant, a sedative, and a cardiovascular protector. The therapeutic actions of Guayusa also make it a potential remedy for anxiety, stress, and digestive issues, due to its ability to stimulate digestion and calm the nervous system.
